stat.title: Roman Josi needs one more for 800
lines: He has 20 points in 17 games this season, and the Predators have won four straight.
Our numbers give him a 65% chance to get there tonight in Los Angeles.
stat.cover_sub: One point from 800 for his career

scorer_notes.8478398: On the ice for 92% of Winnipeg's power-play time
scorer_notes.8481559: Eleven points in his last five games
scorer_notes.8477492: Faces a goalie at .862 over his last five starts
scorer_notes.8477933: Seven points in four games against Columbus

2026020286.title: Toronto looks in the mirror
2026020286.dek: Shut out at home on Sunday, winless in three, and now Nathan MacKinnon walks in.
threads: The slide is earned: 43% of the expected goals in three straight losses, outscored 11-4.
Sergei Bobrovsky has an .862 save rate over his last five starts.
Mackenzie Blackwood stopped all 27 shots in Colorado's last game. Nicolas Roy returns to Toronto for the first time.
2026020286.hunch: A struggling goalie and a team that keeps taking penalties. Our gut says this one gets loud: seven goals or more.

2026020287.title: Something has to give
2026020287.dek: Montreal has points in ten straight. Minnesota has points in eight. Both have a goalie to thank.
threads: Jesper Wallstedt has saved 13.3 goals more than expected this season. Jacob Fowler is right behind at 11.2.
The streaks are not equal: the Wild earned theirs with 57% of the chances. The Canadiens had 50%.
Kirill Kaprizov has points in eight straight. Montreal is missing Ivan Demidov and Mike Matheson.
2026020287.hunch: Our numbers expect about six goals. Our gut says two goalies this hot keep it to 3-2 or tighter.

2026020288.title: Nothing between them
2026020288.dek: Two teams coming off wins, three days' rest apiece, and our numbers can barely split them.
threads: At five on five the Capitals take 54% of the chances. The Senators take 52%.
Alex Ovechkin has gone seven games without a point, on chances worth more than three goals.
Samuel Ersson has been quietly sharp for Ottawa over his last five starts. Ryan Leonard plays his 100th game.
2026020288.hunch: Seven games is a long time for Ovechkin to go without a point, and the chances have been there. Our gut says it ends tonight.

2026020291.title: The homecoming that isn't
2026020291.dek: Connor Hellebuyck is back in Winnipeg, in a Devils sweater. He isn't starting.
threads: New Jersey has won five straight with 61% of the expected goals. This is the Devils at their best.
Jake Allen gets the net, and he has been 4.7 goals worse than expected this season.
Dawson Mercer faces the Devils for the first time after 420 games with them. Jack Hughes has 11 points in his last five.
2026020291.hunch: Our numbers say Devils. Our gut says a building with a point to make, against a backup goalie, is worth more than the model knows: Winnipeg.

2026020289.title: Florida is missing its heart
2026020289.dek: No Aleksander Barkov, no Brad Marchand, and a goalie on a heater waiting in Columbus.
threads: The Panthers are better than their record: poor finishing has cost them about six goals.
Cam Talbot has a .940 save rate over his last five starts.
Brady Tkachuk, now skating with his brother Matthew, has points in four straight. Kent Johnson has points in seven.
2026020289.hunch: Florida's chances say it should win. Our gut says the rested team with the hotter goalie takes it: Columbus.

2026020290.title: Still waiting on Larkin
2026020290.dek: Dylan Larkin is suspended while he waits for a trade. The team he left can't buy a goal.
threads: The Red Wings have scored about 11 fewer goals than their chances deserve.
Both teams are winless in three. The Blues' slide is the real one: 38% of the expected goals.
Justin Faulk returns to St. Louis for the first time, after 482 games as a Blue.
2026020290.hunch: Eleven goals of bad finishing is a debt that gets paid somewhere. Our gut says Detroit collects a little of it tonight.

2026020292.title: Josi at the door of 800
2026020292.dek: Roman Josi is one point from 800 for his career, and Nashville has won four straight.
threads: The streak is earned: 55% of the expected goals in those four wins.
Juuse Saros has saved 6.3 goals more than expected this season.
Erik Haula faces the Predators for the first time since leaving. Mats Zuccarello could return for the Kings.
2026020292.hunch: Our numbers lean Kings at home. Our gut says the hotter team with the better goalie: Nashville, and Josi gets his point.
